Container.Name: bauplan
Container.Overview: Local renovation planner. SQLite database and uploaded documents use separate persistent path mappings.

Config.Name: Web UI Port (host)
Config.Description: Host port for the Bauplan web interface. The container listens internally on port 3000.

Config.Name: Database appdata
Config.Description: Persistent directory for the SQLite database.

Config.Name: Documents
Config.Description: Separate persistent directory for uploaded documents. Can be on another Unraid share or disk.

Config.Name: OCR_URL
Config.Description: Legacy Tesseract default, e.g. http://bauplan-ocr:8000. Admin OCR settings override this value; leave blank if configuring OCR in the app.

Config.Name: OCR settings encryption key
Config.Description: Optional 64-character hexadecimal encryption key, required to store OCR API keys. Generate with openssl rand -hex 32. Preserve separately from database backups.
